name: Standard Layered Architecture
description: Enterprise 4-layer architecture with downward dependency rules

components.name: presentation
components.description: User interface, API controllers, routers, and request handlers

components.name: application
components.description: Application services, use cases, workflow orchestration

components.name: domain
components.description: Core business entities, value objects, domain logic

components.name: infrastructure
components.description: Database adapters, external APIs, persistence, messaging

rules.description: Dependencies must only flow downward through layers. Lower layers cannot depend on upper layers.
Domain core must never depend directly on the presentation layer.
No cyclic dependencies are permitted between architectural components.
